annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulations apply to any person who imports, exports, tests, owns, operates, sells, procures, assembles, manufactures, modifies or maintains an unmanned aircraft system registered in Uganda, including owners, operators and remote pilots.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These Regulations apply to any person who imports, exports, tests, owns, operates, sells, procures, assembles, manufactures, modifies, tests or maintains an unmanned aircraft system registered in Uganda.
annotation.dates_quote: these Regulations are made this 12th day of August, 2022.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: These Regulations may be cited as the Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2022.
